title: Cash sessions
description: Openings and closings per branch and shift: one open session per branch, only the opener can close it, and you cannot open another while yours is open.

sesion.cerrada_hint: Open a session to record payouts and allow charging in Sales.
sesion.abierta_en: You have an open cash session at {{sede}}.
sesion.abierta_hint: Close it at the end of the shift or before opening another at this branch.
sesion.ajena_hint: Opened by {{name}}. Only that person can close it or record payouts.
sesion.tu_otra_sede: You already have a register open
sesion.tu_otra_sede_hint: Your session is at {{sede}}. Close it there before opening here.

abrir.title: Open cash session
abrir.description: Enter the opening cash and, if needed, the balance in Yape, Plin, transfer, Agora, and Sip.
abrir.billeteras_hint: Balance already in each wallet when opening. Leave at 0 if unused.

empty.sesiones_hint: Open the first cash session for this branch.

egreso.description: Choose where the money comes from: cash, Yape, Plin, transfer, Agora, or Sip. It is deducted from that channel in the cash count.

dialog_detalle.title: Session cash count
dialog_detalle.description: Summary of sales, payouts, and shift reconciliation.

fields.saldos_billeteras_hint: Expected balance per channel at closing time.

dialog_cerrar.title: Cash count and closing
dialog_cerrar.description: Review sales, payouts, and methods. Match cash and each wallet balance against expected.
dialog_cerrar.arqueo_error: Could not load this session's cash count.
dialog_cerrar.contado_hint: Count the physical cash in the register before confirming.
dialog_cerrar.billeteras_hint: Balance counted in each digital wallet when closing.
dialog_cerrar.clarify: {{count}} sale(s) this shift for {{total}}. Expected cash {{esperado}}; other methods (card, wallets) {{otros}}; cash payouts {{egresos}}.
dialog_cerrar.anuladas_hint: {{count}} voided sale(s) for {{total}} excluded from the cash count.

dialog_imprimir.title: Print cash count
dialog_imprimir.description: Preview of the closing report as A4 or thermal ticket.
dialog_imprimir.hint_a4: Full report with sales and payout detail.
dialog_imprimir.hint_ticket: Compact summary for a thermal printer.

dialog_reabrir.title: Reopen session
dialog_reabrir.description: This will reopen the closed session. Available up to 24 hours after closing and only if the branch has no other open session.
